blocks.text: Bohat se enzymes catalysis mein madad ke liye kuch izafi (additional) chemical hisse istemal karte hain. Yeh izafi ghair-protein (non-protein) hisse cofactors kehlate hain. Cofactors ki teen qismein hain: metal ions, prosthetic groups aur coenzymes.

blocks.title: Apoenzyme aur holoenzyme
blocks.text: Enzyme ka protein wala hissa apoenzyme kehlata hai, aur cofactor samet poora enzyme holoenzyme kehlata hai.

Bohat se enzymes Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, Mn²⁺, Cu²⁺ aur Zn²⁺ jaise metal ions ko apne cofactors ke taur par istemal karte hain. Yeh metal ions enzyme ke be-kaar (non-functional) active site ko kaam karne wala (functional) bana dete hain. Cofactor ke jurne se enzyme ki shakal bhi badal jati hai aur woh substrate se jur sakta hai (Figure 5.1).

blocks.alt: Teer (arrows) se jure paanch enzyme khaakon ka chakkar (cycle). V jaisi shakal ke active site wala enzyme aur us ke upar substrate; ek cofactor neeche se enzyme ki taraf aata hai; cofactor andar aane par active site aisi shakal le leta hai jo substrate ki dandi (stem) mein fit ho; substrate us mein beth kar enzyme-substrate complex banata hai; do products enzyme se alag hote hain aur cofactor enzyme mein reh jata hai.

Labels: Substrate, Active site, Enzyme, Cofactor, Enzyme-substrate complex, Products.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chakkar ko baen (left) neeche se shuru karein. Pehle enzyme ka active site V jaisa hai, substrate ki chokor dandi us mein fit nahin hoti, yani site ghair-faal (non-functional) hai. Peela cofactor (maslan Mg²⁺ jaisa metal ion) enzyme se jurta hai aur active site ki shakal badal deta hai. Ab substrate fit ho kar enzyme-substrate complex banata hai, aur aakhir mein products alag ho jate hain. Cofactor enzyme ke saath rehta hai.
Kuch cofactors enzyme ke saath covalent bonds (mazboot bonds) banate hain; inhein prosthetic groups kehte hain. Prosthetic group koi organic compound ho sakta hai, maslan hematin.

Jab cofactor ek ghair-protein organic molecule ho aur enzyme se dheela (loosely) jura ho to use coenzyme kehte hain. Coenzymes enzyme wale reactions mein hissa lete hain, aksar electrons (hydrogen atoms) ko ek enzyme se doosre enzyme tak le ja kar. Bohat se vitamins (maslan niacin aur riboflavin) coenzymes ka kaam karte hain, aur kuch vitamins coenzymes ka hissa hote hain. Cell ka sab se aham coenzyme hydrogen lene wala (hydrogen acceptor) nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺) hai. Jab NAD⁺ kisi enzyme se ek hydrogen atom leta hai to reduce ho kar NADH ban jata hai. Hydrogen atom ke electron mein tawanai (energy) hoti hai jo NADH apne saath le jata hai. Maslan jab cell mein khuraak oxidise hoti hai to enzymes khuraak ke molecules se electrons kheench kar NAD⁺ ko dete hain, aur NAD⁺ reduce ho kar NADH ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Trace elements
blocks.text: Molybdenum aur manganese jaise bohat se trace elements (bohat thori miqdar mein zaroori anasir), jo hamari sehat ke liye zaroori hain, enzymes mein cofactors ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek enzyme ko apna substrate badalne ke liye zinc chahiye, aur NAD⁺ doosre se hydrogen le jata hai. Har soorat mein cofactor ki qisam batayen, aur prosthetic group aur coenzyme ka farq samjhayen.
blocks.explanation: Zinc metal ion cofactor hai; NAD⁺ coenzyme hai. Prosthetic group enzyme se covalent bonds se jura hota hai, jabke coenzyme ghair-protein organic molecule hai jo sirf dheela jura hota hai aur electrons ya hydrogen ek enzyme se doosre tak le ja sakta hai.

items: Cofactors ghair-protein madadgar hisse hain: apoenzyme (protein) + cofactor = holoenzyme.

Metal ions (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, Mn²⁺, Cu²⁺, Zn²⁺) active site ko kaam ke qabil banate hain; prosthetic groups (hematin) covalent bonds se jure hote hain; coenzymes (NAD⁺; niacin aur riboflavin jaise vitamins) dheele jure hote hain aur electrons ya hydrogen le jate hain.
NAD⁺ hydrogen le kar NADH banta hai aur electron ki tawanai apne saath le jata hai, maslan jab khuraak oxidise hoti hai.
